Package com.spyj.listener

Class ProjectListener

java.lang.Object
com.spyj.listener.ProjectListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
bluej.extensions2.event.PackageListener
public class ProjectListener extends Object implements bluej.extensions2.event.PackageListener
Listens for BlueJ package (project) lifecycle events and records them as PROJECT_OPENED and PROJECT_CLOSED telemetry events. Implements the BlueJ PackageListener API.

Because a BlueJ project may contain multiple packages, this listener deduplicates open events by project directory so that only the first package-open per project fires a PROJECT_OPENED event.

Close detection is deferred to the JavaFX Application Thread via Platform.runLater(Runnable) so that bluej.getOpenProjects() already reflects the closed state before the event is recorded.

Author:
Mykel Dedier

  • Method Details

    • packageOpened

      public void packageOpened(bluej.extensions2.event.PackageEvent e)
      Called by BlueJ when a package within a project is opened. Pre-populates the class listener with pre-existing classes, then records a PROJECT_OPENED event the first time each project directory is seen. Subsequent package opens within the same project are ignored.
      Specified by:
      packageOpened in interface bluej.extensions2.event.PackageListener
      Parameters:
      e - the BlueJ package event

    • packageClosing

      public void packageClosing(bluej.extensions2.event.PackageEvent e)
      Called by BlueJ when a package within a project is about to close. Defers the actual check and event recording to the JavaFX Application Thread so that bluej.getOpenProjects() reflects the updated project list before the event is logged. Records a PROJECT_CLOSED event only when the entire project has closed (i.e. no remaining packages are open for that project directory).
      Specified by:
      packageClosing in interface bluej.extensions2.event.PackageListener
      Parameters:
      e - the BlueJ package event
